Name: (CP) Upgradable Automated Mining Drills
Author: lminh
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿This mod is based on [b]Automated Mining Drills[/b] of Drewdus42.
I'm just a casual player and love those drills. But the original drill recipe required Battery Pack, which is kinda hard to get before 1st summer. So I made 2 more version of each drill:

[b]LV1: 20 Wood + 45 Stone + 2 Earth Crystal + 10 [drill's products]
[/b] ﻿(except Stone Drill LV1, which will need 60 Stone instead.)
--> Easy to craft but produce less.

[b]LV2: [The drill LV1] + 2 Diamond + 2 [/b][b]Iridium Bar + 1 Battery Pack
[/b]--> Produce faster and better.

[b]LV3: [The drill LV2] + 3 Radioactive Bar + 3 Prismatic Shard
[/b]--> Produce the most and the best.


[b]Mining [/b][b]Skills required to unlock each drill type:
[/b]- Mining 1: Stone
- Mining 4: Clay, Coal, Quartz
- Mining 5: Copper, Iron, Gold
- Mining 6: Bone, Omni-Geode
- Mining 7: Iridium
- Mining 8: Cinder Shard
- Mining 9: Radioactive
- Mining 10: Prismatic Shard

[b][color=#00ff00]WORKS with[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]AUTOMATE[/url]﻿
[color=#e06666][size=4]Please Report any bugs you find or edge cases that aren't behaving as expected
[/size][/color][/b]
